# Independent acceptance expectations

`expected-material-facts.json` is hand-authored from the fixture construction and
pinned protocol formulas. It is not an output snapshot generated by an adapter.
The CPMM vaults hold 10,000/20,000, with 140/260 reserved fees; AMM v4 vault-only
accounting subtracts 100/200 PnL. LP custody samples 450 of a 900 mint supply, while
pool accounting uses 1,000. These denominators must remain distinct.

The ±100 tick position around price one with liquidity 1,000,000 yields floor-rounded
4,987/4,987. At tick 200 it holds 0/9,999 principal with zero active liquidity.
DLMM independently sums covered per-bin principal 250/0 and 500/1,000. DAMM v2's
range fixture separately specifies 500/500 total, 250/250 stored unlocked and 50/50
permanently locked principal. Pump real/virtual reserves and migration status are
separate; PumpSwap LP custody does not imply locking.

The holder sample contains two accounts for the first spending owner, with
2^59 +101 units, and seven for another owner. Its supply is 2^60 +17. No beneficial
ownership or whole-population conclusion follows. A receipt's actual matched token
deltas are −1,000/+500; its fee payer differs from the source/output owner. Quotes
are separate estimates and must never become executed trades.

The acceptance matrix in the implementation plan also maps adversarial cases to the
maintained focused regression suites. New acceptance tests exercise the independent
constants through facts/notes/rendering, contrary controls, sample-sale language,
source-failure resilience and note-to-frozen delivery. No favorable-rating quota is
used; exact scope and substantive evidence matter.
# Retained public Pump allocations

`pump-live-accounts.json` retains exact base64 account bytes and original packet
hashes from the frozen, partial third live acceptance case. These are offline
layout regressions, not current-state evidence for another investigation. The
owning programs' pinned IDL fields at revision
`e0687ae9b7e064a0f54efc7297c65eecfbba3a8f` consume 125 bytes for BondingCurve (115
before its creator-fee/holder-reward tail group) and 271 bytes for Pool (261 before
its tail group). The observed allocations are 124 and 301 bytes: the 124-byte curve
predates the tail group (9 zero bytes, tail absent) and the 301-byte pool holds a
zeroed tail group plus 30 zero bytes. Nonzero padding remains rejected.

At the documented fixed offsets, the completed curve has all four reserve fields
zero and token_total_supply 1,000,000,000,000,000. This cannot prove migration.
The Pool's signed i128 at offset 245 is **17,584,505,289**, not zero. It remains
separate from actual vault custody, and special-mode fee/quote limitations remain.
The upstream README's statement that virtual quote reserves were zero when written
is not substituted for the captured bytes. No existing evidence was rewritten.
